mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its recent 12-month average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, a decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the t-statistic for the decline effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 6-month moving average for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening supply chain and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 6-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has fallen below its 6-month moving average for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month average indicates strong consumer demand for durable goods, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a monthly decline in inflation rate signals a potential easing of monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, a decline in CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the decline is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through enhanced corporate profitability and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
